name: Lavagna (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lavagna (a bend and a tower on yellow) within branches with the scroll ENTELLA, and the inscription CITTÀ DI LAVAGNA in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Lavagna, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Lavagna arms — bend and tower on yellow, crowned, within branches, with scroll ENTELLA
inscription CITTÀ DI LAVAGNA beneath the arms
